summary_1line: Yudhishthira discusses Arjuna’s hardships with Krishna, then joyfully receives Arjuna’s return from the Ashvamedha campaign along with his son Vabhruvahana.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna rides beside the sacrificial horse into the city as crowds praise him and dust rises around the hooves like the celestial steed Uchchaisravas.
Yudhishthira, with Krishna and the Pandavas, goes out to receive Arjuna while the blind Dhritarashtra is placed at the front of the welcoming procession.
Arjuna bows to Dhritarashtra and Yudhishthira and then embraces Krishna after returning from his long campaign.
